title: Balance in the AP foreign-exchange account: realized, unrealized or unexplained
prompt: Investigate the balance in the AP foreign-exchange account. Trace the underlying transactions and determine whether differences are realized, unrealized or unexplained.

setup.q: Which ledger accounts hold foreign-exchange gains and losses (realized and unrealized) for payables?
Which exchange-rate source and rate date does the entity use for bills, payments and month-end revaluation?

inputs.name: FX gains and losses report and revaluation runs for the period

steps: pull the single-account ledger for each FX account for the period and the FX gains-and-losses report and revaluation runs from Dime
trace each posting to its source: a bill paid at a different rate (realized), a month-end revaluation of an open bill (unrealized), or neither
recompute the realized difference for each traced payment from the bill rate and the payment rate stated on the records; quote both rates
classify every posting as realized, unrealized or unexplained; unexplained items are listed one by one with what was looked for
tie the three classes to the account balance at period end

done.text: Realized plus unrealized plus unexplained on the Tie-out equals the FX account balance in Dime's general ledger at the period end
Every exception row cites the ledger transaction id and the bill, payment or revaluation run it traces to
ap-fx-account-analysis.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words

Every posting sits in exactly one class; unexplained items are listed individually with the bill or payment looked for; any change of treatment is raised as a question for the approver, never proposed as an entry
